description: Source code for autosensing control in WAN manager, including functions for initialization, mode setting, start/stop sensing, and interface change notifications.

methods.name: is_sensing_policy
methods.description: Checks if the current sensing policy matches the given policy string.

methods.name: is_autosensing_enabled
methods.description: Determines if autosensing is enabled based on the current operation mode.

methods.name: autosensing_found_mode
methods.description: Marks that sensing at boot has finished and logs if the policy is 'AtBoot'.

methods.name: autosensing_set_wan_mode
methods.description: Sets the WAN mode for autosensing based on provided arguments.

methods.name: register_core_functions
methods.description: Registers core functions for autosensing control.

methods.name: autosensing_init
methods.description: Initializes autosensing module, loads controllers, and registers functions.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_execute_function
methods.description: Executes a specified function within the autosensing module.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_start
methods.description: Starts autosensing with specified current mode sensing.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_stop
methods.description: Stops autosensing and resets related queries.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_notify_intf_changed
methods.description: Notifies autosensing of interface status changes, with optional restart.
